Straight answers

Frequently asked questions

What is the Labour Inspector Grade-I exam pattern?

Under the official Advt 02/2024 plan - 2 hours 30 minutes on OMR. Part A is 50 matric-level Punjabi questions (qualifying, 25 needed, no negative marking). Part B has 100 general questions with 1/4 mark cut per wrong answer. Merit is from Part B.

Is there a labour law paper?

No. Part B is a general paper - GK, Punjab history and culture, reasoning, Punjabi, English and ICT - the same mix as the PSSSB Clerk and Excise Inspector exams.
